records.title: TransitLM: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Map-Free Transit Route Generation
records.reason: The full text presents a dataset and benchmark for map-free public-transit route generation with text models. Its contribution is task/data/evaluation quality, not an inference efficiency or serving mechanism; the linked lineages do not establish a technical systems connection.

records.title: ImplicitTerrainV2: Wavelet-Guided Spatially Adaptive Neural Terrain Representation
records.reason: The paper proposes a compact spatially adaptive implicit neural representation for digital elevation terrain tiles, evaluated on terrain reconstruction and gradient fidelity. It does not concern language models or LLM inference/serving.

records.title: The Attribution Contract for Generative Language Models
records.reason: The paper defines attribution requirements and compares attribution behavior for generative language models. Its contribution is accountability/attribution semantics; no inference resource, latency, throughput, or serving optimization is proposed.
